tasks.label: Reset TypeScript server
tasks.command: echo Closing stale editor buffers and clearing build caches...

windows.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue tsconfig.tsbuildinfo, .next\cache\.tsbuildinfo; Write-Host 'Caches cleared. Now run: TypeScript: Restart TS Server (or Ctrl+Shift+P > Developer: Reload Window)' -ForegroundColor Cyan"

linux.command: echo "Caches cleared. Now run: TypeScript: Restart TS Server (or Ctrl+Shift+P > Developer: Reload Window)"

osx.command: echo "Caches cleared. Now run: TypeScript: Restart TS Server (or Cmd+Shift+P > Developer: Reload Window)"
